name: service-mesh-resilience-lab
description: E-Commerce web application used as a lab for service-mesh resilience engineering with OpenTelemetry and chaos experiments (MSc IT final-year project).

scripts.build:services: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @ecommerce/user-service && npm run build -w @ecommerce/product-service && npm run build -w @ecommerce/order-service && npm run build -w @ecommerce/ops-service
scripts.build: npm run build:services && npm run build -w @ecommerce/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n user,product,order,ops,web -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green,blue "npm run dev -w @ecommerce/user-service" "npm run dev -w @ecommerce/product-service" "npm run dev -w @ecommerce/order-service" "npm run dev -w @ecommerce/ops-service" "npm run dev -w @ecommerce/web"
scripts.dev:services: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n user,product,order,ops -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npm run dev -w @ecommerce/user-service" "npm run dev -w @ecommerce/product-service" "npm run dev -w @ecommerce/order-service" "npm run dev -w @ecommerce/ops-service"
scripts.start:services: npm run build:services && concurrently -k "npm run start -w @ecommerce/user-service" "npm run start -w @ecommerce/product-service" "npm run start -w @ecommerce/order-service" "npm run start -w @ecommerce/ops-service"
